beats.say: In nineteen sixty-nine, the government told Parliament it couldn't afford it, 'at present'.
beats.cap: 1969: Govt told Parliament: not possible 'at present' (money)

beats.say: A railway down India's western Konkan coast, for about sixty crore rupees.
Its first sixty-two kilometres opened only in nineteen eighty-six.
In nineteen ninety, a new company was set up. A Swedish aid review says: to raise the money.
beats.cap: 1990: Konkan Railway Corporation · Sida: set up to raise the money

beats.say: The deadline: four and a half years. Even the builder called that unrealistic.
beats.cap: Target: 4.5 years · KRCL: 'by no means realistic'

beats.say: The worst part was tunnelling through soft soil in Goa.
beats.cap: Hardest: soft-soil tunnels, mainly in Goa (Sida)

beats.say: The whole line opened on Republic Day, nineteen ninety-eight.
'Not at present' in sixty-nine. Open end to end by ninety-eight.
